title: Sid Dash
blurb: A Trouble Makers game: run Sid up the street to his house and on to school, dodge cars and wet floors, and grab all 3 stars to reach the next stage. Unlock crazy-eyed Scott and his poo hats.
controls: Swipe left or right to change lanes, swipe up to hop, tap the red button to pause. Switch between 2D and 3D from the menu or the pause screen. Arrow keys work too.
